title: The $4,824 Kickback Hidden in Your Car Loan
hook: Your car dealer pocketed nearly five thousand dollars from your lender the day you drove home — and it came straight out of your interest rate.
angle: Dealer reserve is a legal, hidden rate markup that costs Americans $14 billion a year — almost no buyer knows it exists or how to avoid it.
audience: Anyone who has ever financed a car through a dealership or plans to buy a car in the next 12 months
key_numbers: $4,824 average hidden markup on a $35K, 5-year loan at 2.5% dealer reserve
85% of new cars are financed through the dealer
$14 billion in dealer reserve extracted from Americans every year
Credit unions average 1.9% lower APR than dealer-offered rates
